models.fd: Frequency-dependent (GridKit vector fits / PSCAD FD phase model)
models.bg: Lossless Bergeron (constant 60 Hz L and C in both tools)

energize.name: energize
energize.description: Energization of the open-ended line from zero state: the source amplitude rises from 0 to 1 over 50 us at 1 ms, launching a steep front that reflects off the open receiving end.

fault.name: fault
fault.description: Sinusoidal steady state into the R-L load (2 Zc, pf 0.95), then a phase-A 6.8 ohm receiving-end fault applied at 20 ms (50 us transition) and removed over 2 ms at 60 ms.

pulse.name: pulse
pulse.description: Surge test from zero state: a phase-A pulse of 5.6 kV (5 us rise, 50 us FWHM) from a 30 ohm + 20 uH source into a 410 ohm termination.

sag.name: sag
sag.description: Sinusoidal steady state into the R-L load (2 Zc, pf 0.95); the phase-A source amplitude sags by 40% from 20 to 50 ms (50 us transitions). Smooth operation lets the adaptive solver step over the line delay.
